title: A Primer of the Falchion Grip
summary: Teaches a first-time student how to hold, lift and drop the heavy falchion in plain chops using body strength alone.

title: Handbook of the Chopping Cut
summary: Sets out the overhead, slanting and rising chops of the falchion with a post-drill for students who have begun hardening the skin.

title: Drill-Book of the Heavy Single Edge
summary: Builds the arm and wrist for the falchion's weight through slow hacking drills and edge alignment for muscle-stage students.

title: Workbook of Falchion Footing
summary: Teaches the stances, steps and pivots that let the heavy falchion fall without unbalancing a student whose tendons are hardening.

title: Plain Treatise on the Curved Chop
summary: Explains how the curved back and swelling belly of the falchion shape each draw, hack and return stroke for bone-stage students.

title: Canon of the Hanging Guard
summary: Presents the hanging guards and flat-blade knocks that let a body-only student cover himself behind the broad falchion.

title: Primer of Qi at the Falchion Edge
summary: Shows a newly awakened student how to run a thread of qi into the falchion's edge for plain chops and guards.

title: Handbook of the Weighted Cut
summary: Teaches the circulating student to time a pulse of qi to the instant the falchion's forward weight lands.

title: Drill-Book of the Rolling Wrist
summary: Drills the rolling wrist that carries the falchion through chained chops, with qi guiding the arc for circulating students.

title: Workbook of Falchion Reach and Recovery
summary: Teaches circulating students to extend a chop to full reach and recover the heavy blade before an answer.

title: Short Canon of the Falchion Cleave
summary: Gathers the six plain cleaving strokes of the falchion, each paired with a breath of qi, for senior-level students.
